title.zh: 修订第4206号共和国法（题为“禁止向公立初等与中级学校学童收取捐款”）的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand Two Hundred Six Entitled "An Act Prohibiting the Collection of Contributions from School Children of Public Primary and Intermediate Schools"
title.orig: An Act to Amend Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand Two Hundred Six Entitled "An Act Prohibiting the Collection of Contributions from School Children of Public Primary and Intermediate Schools"

title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 4206

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4725_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 1 of the Republic Act Numbered Four thousand two hundred six is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The collection of contributions for the Anti-Tuberculosis, Parent-Teacher Associations, School Athletic Meets, Medical and Dental Services or for any other project or purpose, whether voluntary or otherwise, from school children and teachers of public primary, intermediate and high schools is hereby prohibited: Provided, However, That this prohibition shall not cover membership fees of school children in the Red Cross, the girl scouts of the Philippines and the boy scouts of the Philippines."

The title of Republic Act Numbered four thousand two hundred six is hereby amended to read as follows:
"An Act Prohibiting the Collection of Contributions from School Children of Public Primary, Intermediate and High Schools"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
